{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any non-numeric values after conversion
print(sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum())

# Show the first few rows to confirm
sales_df.head()"}
